structure.title: The 14 Parts of HUMG English Exit Exam
structure.subtitle: Follows the Cambridge KET (A2 Key) format across 2 main skill blocks completed in 60 minutes.
structure.readingWritingMeta: 50 multiple-choice & fill-in questions · 1 short written note

parts.p1: Part 1: Signs & Notices (Match descriptions to notices A-H)
parts.p2: Part 2: Vocabulary (Choose A/B/C for short sentence gaps)
parts.p5: Part 5: Text Completion (Cloze text with options A/B/C)
parts.p6: Part 6: Word Guessing (Dictionary definitions with letter hints)
parts.p7: Part 7: Word Completion (Write one word for each gap in letters)
parts.p8: Part 8: Form Filling (Extract key details from notes to form)
parts.p9: Part 9: Short Note Writing (Write a 25-35 word message covering 3 points)
parts.p10: Part 10: Listening 1 (5 short dialogues with picture choices A/B/C)
parts.p11: Part 11: Listening 2 (Match items or plans with reasons A-H)
parts.p13: Part 13: Listening 4 (Fill missing information into notes)
parts.p14: Part 14: Listening 5 (Listen and record key details on sheet)

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Key information you need to prepare for the English exit test at HUMG.
faq.q1: What format does the HUMG English Exit Exam follow?
faq.a1: The exit test follows the Cambridge KET (A2 Key) structure, featuring 14 parts divided into Reading & Writing (Parts 1-9) and Listening (Parts 10-14), spanning 60 total minutes.
faq.q2: Can I practice on mobile phones?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely. The website is fully responsive across mobile phones (375px+), tablets, and desktops. Touch targets and font sizes follow accessibility best practices.
faq.q3: If I lose connection or reload during a mock test, is my progress lost?
faq.a3: No. The system uses continuous autosave. When you reload or reconnect, your answered items and remaining time are seamlessly restored from the server.
faq.q4: Are the score lookup results official?
faq.a4: The lookup feature directly integrates the official portal of HUMG CFI Foreign Languages and Informatics Center (kqt.cfi.humg.edu.vn). Data is loaded directly without third-party storage.
